text: This report responds to the various fireworks related City Council directives received from May through July 2021. The report also provides updates on actions taken to mitigate unpermitted/illegal fireworks use, public education initiatives undertaken during the 2021 warm weather season, and plans for the 2022 warm weather season. In recent years, there has been an increase in unpermitted/illegal consumer fireworks use and emergency incidents related to fireworks in Toronto, especially in parks, public spaces, and waterfront areas. In response, City Council directed staff to review the feasibility of restricting both the retail sale and use of consumer fireworks by the public.
